name: Otter AI
description: AI-powered meeting transcription, notes, and collaboration tool with public API and MCP server support
primary_blocker: Public API requires an Otter Enterprise plan and admin permissions or partner account manager enablement.

evidence.claim: Otter.ai's Public API provides programmatic access to retrieve channels, conversations, transcripts, audio, action items, insights, outlines, and workspace details from your Otter account for Enterprise plan.
Otter REST API is secured by OAuth 2.0.
Otter provides an official MCP Server for connecting AI models like Claude and ChatGPT using Model Context Protocol.

notes: Otter provides an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Claude and ChatGPT integration. Its standard public REST API requires Enterprise access.
